newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P rates Fajar Surya Wisesa credit B+.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Fajar Surya Wisesa credit B+.

text.p: Standard & Poors rating agency said on Tuesday it assigned its long-term corporate credit rating of B+ to P.T. Fajar Surya Wisesa.
It also assigned a B+ rating to Fajar unit FSW International Finance Company B.V's guaranteed secured notes due 2006, the agency said.
The outlook was stable, Standard & Poor added.

Fajar's rating reflected its solid market position, strong growth in domestic demand and a competitive cost position, offset by concentrated exposure to the Indonesian industrial paper market, a lack of vertical integration and aggressive financial profile and a large capital expenditure plan, it said.
Fajar is the second-largest industrial paper manufacturer in Indonesia, supplying the strongly growing domestic demand for paper packaging.
